manifest.author: RAPP / AIBAST
manifest.description: Generates a self-contained HTML executive pitch deck from a topic — one LLM call shapes the narrative, a fixed template assembles the slides.
manifest.example_call: Generate an executive pitch deck for our internal agent-sharing proposal, framed as a contribution that complements existing tooling
manifest.name: @rapp/pitch_deck_agent

audience.description: Who the pitch is for (default: 'executive leadership')

output_path.description: Absolute path for the output HTML. Default: ./pitches/<slug>-pitch.html

product_name.description: Name of the product/initiative shown on slides

topic.description: What the pitch is about (e.g. 'internal agent sharing proposal')
